Anika (CEO): Short follow-up from today's AH Q&A focused on contracts, pricing signals, and support tiers. Posting clarifications + owners. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23-contracts (org-only).

Raj (Head of Sales): A few enterprise reps asked whether Dedicated pilot pricing will be discounted vs GA, and how support SLAs differ for pilot customers.

Maya (Legal): For pilots we typically do a time-bound appendix rather than a full discount clause. Suggest: pilot rate card + a 30% introductory credit applied as a billing credit. Legal will draft appendix template.

Leah (Customer Success): Support for pilot: concierge onboarding + 1-week post-migration support included. For GA we'll map support tiers to pricing page. Need Sales to confirm expectations.

Priya (VP Product): Also clarifying: Dedicated SLA metrics apply at GA. For pilot customers we will publish expected perf targets but they won't be SLA-backed until 2026-06-01 per leadership note.

Raj (Head of Sales): OK, will tell customers pilot = early access + credits + concierge; GA = SLA + published pricing. I'll update sales playbook.

Maya (Legal): Action: I'll produce a pilot appendix template and a short checklist of consent items (telemetry retention, KMS terms, audit access).

ops-bot: Calendar reminder: "AH follow-ups: Contracts & Pilot pricing sync" 2026-03-29 11:00 PST.

Anika (CEO): Action items below. Please add JIRA links when you open tasks. If anyone can't meet dates, flag by 2026-03-25.

Action items:
- Maya (Legal) -> draft pilot appendix + consent checklist due 2026-03-30
- Raj (Head of Sales) -> update sales playbook & pilot FAQ, post draft here due 2026-03-28
- Leah (Customer Success) -> draft concierge onboarding schedule and support runbook due 2026-03-27
- Priya (VP Product) -> publish pilot perf expectations doc and note about SLA start date due 2026-03-26

Priya (VP Product): I'll link the perf expectations doc to the Console early-access page once ready.

Leah (Customer Success): Will coordinate onboarding dates with Sales after playbook update.

Anika (CEO): Thanks all  will check in at next weekly leadership sync. :white_check_mark:
